title: Roadhouse 4am
style: 78 BPM slow burn blues rock, dirty Telecaster guitar, Hammond B3 organ, upright bass, brushed snare drums, smoky male blues lead, female smoky harmony, late night roadhouse, dynamic build
lyrics:
[Intro - dirty Tele bends, organ swells, brushes on snare]
(spoken, gravelly, male)
four in the morning.
the last drink is the slowest drink.
so is the last truth.

[Verse 1 - male blues lead, smoky]
the jukebox quit on the second to last song
the waitress went home with somebody wrong
the bartender's wiping the same glass twice
like if he keeps it up he'll come out clean and nice

the parking lot's empty except for one truck
belongs to a man who long ago ran out of luck
he's not waiting for anyone, he's waiting for himself
to admit what he's been hiding on the top of the shelf

[Chorus - female harmony joins, organ swells]
roadhouse four am
the truth comes slow but the truth comes in
roadhouse four am
ain't no clock, just the man you've been

[Verse 2 - male, slightly bigger]
the neon out front buzzes like a tired bee
spelling out half a word that used to read free
now it just says ree, like the start of a regret
like the part of the story he ain't told nobody yet

the stool he's on has known him fifteen years
it's heard every version of his hopes and fears
it don't take notes, it don't take sides
it just holds him up while the night decides

[Chorus]
roadhouse four am
the truth comes slow but the truth comes in
roadhouse four am
ain't no clock, just the man you've been

[Bridge - guitar solo, dirty Tele, organ underneath]
(no vocal, two passes, second one bigger)

[Verse 3 - male, quietest]
he finally pays his tab and walks to the door
the bartender nods like he's done this before
outside the air is cold and the sky is bruise-blue
and the man says out loud, i know what i gotta do

[Final Chorus - female harmony full, organ huge]
roadhouse four am
the truth comes slow but the truth comes in
roadhouse four am
ain't no clock, just the man you've been
roadhouse four am
the truth comes slow but the truth comes in
roadhouse four am
gonna be the man i shoulda been

[Outro - guitar tail, organ fade, spoken]
four in the morning.
last drink. last lie.
go home, brother. go home.
